items.label: 🥇From BIGROSE — The X-Power Full-Back Posture Support Pro
items.value: Experience professional-grade full-back posture correction and lumbar support trusted by over 15 million users worldwide. At BIGROSE, we use only premium high-strength materials engineered for stable posture support, lasting durability, and everyday comfort.

items.label: ✅Industry-First Power-X Strap System
items.value: Our back support brace features an industry-first X-shaped adjustable tension architecture. Two sets of customizable compression straps—upper and lower—distribute force evenly across a wider support area, delivering a more secure, contoured, three-dimensional fit. This design reinforces weak lumbar muscles, enabling effective posture correction and back pain relief.

items.label: ✅18-Day Posture Training Support
items.value: The adjustable shoulder straps, X-structure design, and four fiberglass support rods work together to form a full-back support frame that helps correct posture, deliver targeted lumbar support, and relieve back and lower back pain caused by slouching and long sitting—keeping your back stable and confident in daily movement.

items.label: ✅Made for Office Work, Study, Walking & All-Day Wear
items.value: Designed for men and women, students, office workers, and older adults who spend long hours sitting, standing, or moving. The lightweight, breathable mesh construction keeps you cool and comfortable, allowing it to be worn discreetly under clothing for extended periods without underarm pressure or overheating.

items.label: ✅Trusted by Millions, Backed by BIGROSE
items.value: Includes BIGROSE X-Power Full-Back Posture Support Pro ×1 and user guide ×1, backed by industry-leading BIGROSE Care and lifetime technical support.
